summary: Evraklar (Documents) feature tested successfully. All 9 features verified: 1) Courier Evraklar tab visible when documents incomplete, 2) All 7 document types displayed correctly, 3) Image upload working, 4) PDF upload working, 5) Progress bar updates correctly, 6) Admin detail modal has Evraklar tab, 7) Admin can view/delete documents, 8) Admin can download ZIP, 9) Tab visibility based on document completion status.

Evraklar page loads with all 7 document types
Document types displayed: Sözleşme (14), Kimlik Ön/Arka (1 each), Ehliyet Ön/Arka (1 each), Adli Sicil (1 PDF), İkametgah (1 PDF)
Upload button visible for each incomplete document type
Image upload (PNG) successful for Kimlik Ön Yüz
Uploaded file shows with checkmark in document list
Admin Kuryeler page loads with courier list

Modal has Bilgiler and Evraklar tabs

critical_code_review_comments: Document upload correctly validates file types (images for ID/license, PDF for criminal record/residence)
File naming convention includes courier name and document type for easy identification
